summaryTemplate: Full Stack Senior Lead Software Engineer with 10.5+ years in enterprise SaaS, working across React, TypeScript, and Node.js. Currently leading an engineering team on a platform serving 4,000+ MSP and IT enterprise customers, driving technical direction across AI-native engineering with LLM orchestration, MCP servers, and production agent skills. {seeking}
snapshot: AI test-authoring platform that generates, runs, and self-heals end-to-end suites, reducing manual QA effort.
Headless Base UI design system with customised design tokens and a custom AI agent that generates production components from a Figma link, reducing page development from 2 days to a few hours.
96% faster builds, from 2 minutes to 5 seconds across 12 packages, saving hundreds of engineering hours a month.
70% faster initial page load, 5 seconds down to 1.5 seconds through route-level code splitting, React lazy loading, and per-package bundle chunking.
4,000+ enterprise customers served through platform-wide migrations, technical debt reduction, and regression automation delivered without disrupting the platform.
Mentored 10+ engineers across SuperOps and Freshworks, reducing onboarding ramp-up time.

experience.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
bullets: Ship major product features end-to-end in React and TypeScript as a hands-on contributor, delivering high-quality software on schedule with product managers and UI/UX designers.

Lead and manage a frontend team of 4 to 6 engineers on a platform serving 4,000+ MSP and IT enterprise customers, owning sprint planning, architecture reviews, hiring and interviews, performance feedback and career development, and roadmap prioritisation with product managers.

Reduced build time by 96%, from 2 minutes to 5 seconds, through a solo Webpack 5 to Rspack migration delivered in 3 weeks across 12 monorepo packages, saving hundreds of engineering hours per month and accelerating time-to-market for every downstream feature.

Reduced manual regression effort and release risk by architecting an AI test-authoring platform in React and Node.js that orchestrates LLM agents to generate, execute, and self-heal end-to-end test suites over HTTP Web Streams, backed by a 300+ test-case Playwright regression suite in Jenkins CI/CD.

Improved developer productivity by integrating custom Claude Code skills and MCP servers into the production development workflow, with multi-tier write-scope guardrails that let engineers run autonomous agents safely, and built a Python MCP server exposing the frontend codebase as a queryable graph, now used by AI tooling across multiple engineering teams.

Built a headless Base UI design system on customised design tokens and a Claude Code skill that generates production components from a Figma node link via MCP, reducing page development from 2 days to a few hours, alongside a reusable UI SDK framework and architectural standards adopted across product teams.

Optimised application performance through route-level code splitting, React lazy loading (Suspense), and per-package bundle chunking, and removed dead code and unused dependencies to reduce technical debt and the build and security surface.
Delivered enterprise features including role-based access control (RBAC) and near-real-time operational dashboards, tuning custom cached Apollo hooks to balance data freshness against network load.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer (Customer-Facing Engineering)
bullets: Acted as the technical point of contact for enterprise customers, partnering with Support, Customer Success, and Sales to turn complex account requirements into solutions that unblocked onboarding and renewals.
Reduced support handling effort by building a Customer 360 dashboard consolidating support, sales, and account data into a single operational view.
Integrated tier-1 SaaS systems including Jira, Salesforce, Zendesk, and ServiceNow through REST API services, expanding platform fit in enterprise deals.
Delivered reusable add-ons and supporting REST API services to meet customer-specific requirements without one-off custom development.
Mentored 6 to 7 junior and onboarding engineers on React, REST API development, and UI architecture through structured code and design reviews, accelerating team onboarding.

Developed features end-to-end across Freshworks products, building the React UI with the Node.js REST API services and MySQL data layer behind it, delivering enterprise requirements without depending on a separate backend team.

experience.title: Software Developer
experience.company: Niche Video Media, LLC / Infigenic, LLC (acquired by Freshworks) — Chennai & Bengaluru, India
bullets: Built an admin dashboard that dynamically priced Stripe plans across feature selection, storage tiers, and bandwidth limits, increasing self-serve revenue.
Built video player customisation from scratch with configurable controls, annotations, and call-to-action overlays, increasing viewer conversion.
Built responsive, high-converting company and product landing pages in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
Integrated Freshservice with DocuSign over REST API services to extend enterprise workflow coverage, joining Freshworks with the team on acquisition.
